howto: Tap the golden wheat in your garden beds to harvest it, then tap an empty bed to plant again.
Follow the task card: it always names your next step, and Show me takes you straight there.
Use the bar along the bottom (the left rail on phones) to Grow, Raise animals, Produce treats, Trade and Build.
Meet Milo, June, Hazel and Theo and finish the twelve chapters of the Lantern Fair story.
tips: Drag across several ripe beds in one stroke to harvest them all at once.
Hungry animals eat wheat and berries; collect eggs, milk and wool from Milo's paddock when they are ready.
Crops and bakery batches keep growing while the game is closed.
The trader's boat docks at the harbour after Chapter 2: fill its crates for a big reward.
Open the Barn to see everything you have stored, and upgrade it before it fills up.

controls.keyboard: Click to walk and use things, or WASD to walk and Space for the nearest action. G shows your task, Q and E turn the camera, the wheel zooms, right-drag pans, Esc closes a menu.
controls.touch: Tap the ground to walk; tap beds, buildings, animals and neighbours to use them; drag across beds to harvest many at once. The menus sit on the left rail (More shows the rest).

difficulty: A relaxed farm and life sim with no fail state: crops, animals and batches take real minutes, and the story opens one chapter at a time.

cheats.effect: Every planted crop is ready to harvest
Unlock every building in the Build menu

settings.quality: Menu > Settings > Graphics: Shadows on or off, Smooth edges on or off, and Render scale (lower is faster and softer)
settings.sound: Menu > Settings > Sound: master, music, effects, Claire's voice, ambience and interface volumes, plus Mute all

features.autosave: Every harvest, purchase and chapter saves at once, and the day clock and needs save every 30 seconds (browser IndexedDB, /userfs)
features.goals-or-quests: The task card: five starter goals, then the twelve chapters of the Lantern Fair story, each with Show me and a coin reward
features.day-time-ui: Day number, morning, afternoon or evening and the clock under Claire's name; the sky dims through dusk and the village lanterns glow at night
features.inventory: The Barn (the Barn quick button on desktop, or Menu > Shared barn on any screen) lists every good you hold, the barn's capacity and its upgrade
features.tutorial: Milo's welcome and the first-harvest goal on a new farm; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu brings them back
features.results: Each finished goal and chapter shows a reward card; the Lantern Fair finale ends with credits and Keep playing
features.codes-on: Using a code marks the farm Codes on for good (a red tag under the header) and pauses its achievements
